Attention! From the first of November, public transport fares in the city will double, and discounts for pensioners and students will be scrapped completely. We were told this by a source in the city council who asked to remain anonymous. The authorities are silent and hiding the truth, because the decision was already made at a closed meeting. We are being deceived again: they promised modernisation, and now they are simply taking money out of ordinary people's pockets. Bus and tram tickets will be so expensive that half the city simply won't get to work. Officials, as always, ride in official cars and don't see the problems. According to the source, the document is already signed and will be made public at the very last moment so that nobody has time to protest. They say the next step will be cancelling night routes and cutting trams by half. None of the officials answer journalists' questions, and that means only one thing: it's all true. Share this information with your family and friends while it's not too late. If we stay silent now, tomorrow we will pay even more. Don't trust official statements.
